correctness.rationale: The claimed explicit formula is not defined under its stated domains. For (a,b,c)=(2,2,4), r=2,s=0,t=1 requires H_q(2,4;1); its u=2 term requires N_q(0,1), outside 0≤t≤v. In the proof an isotropic radical of dimension u leaves a 2(v−u)-dimensional symplectic quotient, so a nondegenerate 2t-plane requires u≤v−t. Replacing the upper bound by min(v−t,h−2t), or explicitly defining N outside its range to be zero, would fix this. The supplied artifacts/verify_tripartite.py (lines 27–33, inspected but not executed) in fact uses this zero extension, unlike the frozen formula. The remainder of the derivation supports the corrected expression: elimination of the X hyperbolic block leaves C and PᵀJP, elimination of the s paired C coordinates leaves the restriction on ker C (the inverse pairing block has lower-right block zero), and a specified P|ker C has q^(2rs) extensions. The symplectic basis and surjection counts hold in characteristic two as well. For odd q the edge center and commutator coincide and a central additive character, written using a fixed nontrivial additive character of F_q and an F_q-linear edge functional, yields a radical of size q^(n−2j); induction from a maximal isotropic subgroup gives degree q^j and that many representations. Independent exact evaluation with the corrected range gave the five stated K₃,₃,₃/F₃ coefficients and multiplicities, with totals 3²⁷ and 3³⁶; replay: /workspace/branches/1bc60fc1-44fc-4adf-9cfe-9ef24f191274/k333_recompute.py. This is evaluation of the finite sum, not brute force. VERIFICATION.md documents the finite checks, not a proof or formal certificate.
